To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 1,4-diarylbuta-1,3-dien-1-ones are the most potent anti-invasive chalcone analogs, and the 1,ω-diphenylalkenones are the most toxic.
the chalcone and 1,3-dien-1-ones are potent inhibitors of tumor cell invasion.
1,3-Diarylpropenones and 1,3-diphenyl-1,3-butadiene derivatives were potent anti-invasive agents in the chick heart assay.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of new anti-invasive agents.

the design of novel, potent, and nontoxic anti-invasive chemotherapeutic agents, and our current results indicate that the 1,ω-diphenylethenes and the 1,5-diarylpentadienes are promising lead structures for further optimization.
the design and synthesis of new anti-invasive agents, with the aim of developing new chemotherapeutic drugs for the treatment of invasive cancers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 1,ω-phenyl-ω-phenylethenones (chalcone and related) are more promising than the 1,4-diaryl-2-pentene-1,4-dione series.

the anti-invasive activity of the 1,ω-phenylalkenone series is not promising, whereas the 1,5- and 1,3-diphenyl-1,3-diynones and the 1,1,3-triaryl-2,3-diprop-2-enylidenepropan-1-ones are still interesting and warrant further studies.
the 1,ω-phenyl-1,ω-arylpenta-3-en-4-ones, with ω=3, 4, and 5, are not promising as new anti-invasive agents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the 1,ω-bis(4-hydroxyphenyl)alkenones (1,ω-diarylmethenones), 1,ω-diphenylalkenones, 1,3-bis(4-methoxyphenyl)prop-2-en-1-ones and 1,3- bis(4-hydroxymethylphenyl)propen-1-ones (chalcone) are all potent anti-invasive compounds, while
the chalcone scaffold seems optimal for the development of potent anti-invasive compounds.
a 1,3-phenylene bridge between the aromatic moities is optimal for anti-invasive activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
1,3,5-triaryl-2,4,6-trien-1-ones are not good chemotypes in the chick invasion assay.
it is possible to make potent anti-invasive compounds, but that the potency is not easily transferred from one chemotype to the next.
the 1,2,3-trisubstituted aromatic ring is a critical feature in the design of potent anti-invasive chemotype.
